artworks.title: "Paint Me" - Apachee
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: This painting shows a group of people standing together outdoors. In the center of the group is a person with red-and-white body paint creating intricate designs on their otherwise nude body. The rest of the people form a line behind them, and these people are dressed in tan garments including shawls and tunics. Some of them have red, white, and black feathers in their dark hair. A child on the far right holds a pot on their head, while another person on the left carries a long spear and what looks like a fan of feathers. Many of the people wear decorative necklaces and earrings. The ground is grassy, and surrounding the feet of the central person are several items such as shoes, a shield-like object, a quiver, and a curved object. The background shows a grassy plain meeting a pale-blue sky. Surrounding the central painting is a border of white paper, and around that is a pale-green frame.

artworks.title: Nishnabotana Bluffs, Upper Missouri
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image features a landscape with green hills in the background, adorned with trees and bushes. The brushstrokes blend smoothly, creating soft contours. The dominant colors are green and blue, with hints of pink in the sky. A group of people is seated in the foreground.

artworks.title: Camanchees Lancing a Buffalo Bull
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: This is a painting of a hunting scene with a bison in a grassy landscape. The bison is surrounded by three horse-mounted hunters. The hunters are flanking the bison from different angles. The horses are depicted in motion, with harnesses suggesting speed. The bison is detailed, with textured fur and a powerful presence. The sky above is depicted in lighter tones. The style is reminiscent of George Catlin, known for his detailed artworks of Native American culture and wildlife.

artworks.title: Wounded Buffalo Bull
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The painting shows a wounded bison in a prairie landscape, with other bison in the distance. The style focuses on detail and texture in the fur and grass. The color palette is earthy, with dark browns for the bison and muted greens and yellows for the grasslands against a sky transitioning from turquoise to gray. The scene conveys a sense of openness and solitude.

artworks.title: Dying Buffalo Bull
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a lone bison on a grassy plain. The viewpoint is slightly above the bison, with the horizon high in the composition. The sky above the horizon is painted with soft brushstrokes in gray, blue, and faint pink. The bison's fur and the landscape appear in earthy browns and greens, contrasting with the cooler sky tones.

artworks.title: View of Chicago in 1837
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a scene where natural and human elements coexist. There is a sandy area with people and conical tents. A river curves towards the horizon, with a strip of blue sea or sky visible. Along the river, there are structures resembling houses. The brushstrokes are fine and deliberate, capturing details. The color palette includes earthy tones of green and brown against the blue sky and water.

artworks.title: American Pasturage - Prairies of the Platte
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard

artworks.title: View of the Lower Mississippi
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a dense forest with tall trees forming a canopy. Human figures walk on a ridge. A canoe with figures paddles along a river at the base of the cliff. The color palette is green and brown.

artworks.title: Cedar Bluffs
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a grassy landscape with a slightly elevated view. The horizon is near the upper third of the frame, revealing a vast sky with light clouds. A river winds through the land in the distance, bordered by trees. Bison are scattered across the grassy hill, with more visible moving towards the horizon. The brushstrokes are smooth, creating a realistic and detailed depiction. The color palette consists of lush greens, browns, and a vibrant blue sky, creating visual harmony.

artworks.title: Caddoe Indians Gathering Wild Strawberries
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard

artworks.title: Indian File - Iowa
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The illustration shows a landscape with a rolling green hill dominating the scene. The horizon is high in the composition, with a line of marching figures extending into the distance, creating depth. The sky above has a mix of blue and grey with scattered clouds. Closest to us, a line of figures carrying shields or circular objects march in unison across the greenery. The brushstrokes are smooth and meticulous, delineating forms with precision. The color palette consists of earthy greens and browns, with the figures wearing reddish-brown attire.

artworks.title: Mired Buffalo and Wolves
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts a vast landscape with a horizon line dividing the sky and prairie fields. Large herds of buffalo are scattered on the plains, visible as dark silhouettes. The ground is covered in green vegetation and trees, with brushstrokes indicating movement. Wolves are gathered around a fallen buffalo, depicted in detail. The color palette includes earthy greens and browns for the ground and trees, contrasting with pastel blues and pinks of the sky.

artworks.title: A Whale Ashore - Klahoquat
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a beach scene with numerous small figures engaged in activities on the sand. The sea stretches out to the horizon, with clouds and a sailboat visible. The sky gradient transitions from deep orange near the horizon to softer blues and yellows higher up. The water contrasts with the sky in cooler shades. The overall palette is harmonious, with warm earth tones in the sand and vibrant blues and oranges in the sky and sea, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Excavating a Canoe - Nayas Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people constructing a large wooden canoe in a dense forest setting. The point of view is slightly elevated, providing a clear view of the scene set beneath tall trees. The horizon is not distinctly visible due to the tall trees. The painting style uses smooth brushstrokes with detailed attention to the leaves and branches. The color palette is rich and earthy, dominated by greens, browns, and soft reds and tans. Several figures are carving and hollowing out a log on the ground, with others engaged in different activities. The forest background is lush with shades of green and brown blending into one another.

artworks.title: Launching a Canoe - Nayas Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in a forest setting near a body of water. The horizon is low in the image, with lush green vegetation and tall trees in the background. People are carrying a large wooden canoe through a clearing. The color palette includes earthy greens, browns, and the blue of the water, with some individuals wearing red garments.

artworks.title: An Indian Council - Sioux
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The painting shows a semi-circular gathering of figures with feathered headdresses and blankets, seated around a central figure. Low vegetation and clouds can be seen on the horizon, with soft and blended brushstrokes used throughout. The color palette includes earthy tones for the figures and tree, and lighter blues and whites for the sky and clouds.

artworks.title: Grizzly Bears Attacking Buffalo
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a group of bison in motion, some in a trench and others on the grassy landscape. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, providing a wide view of the scene. The horizon is high with hills, trees, and a vast sky in the background. The brushstrokes give a detailed texture to the bison and the landscape. Earthy tones dominate the color palette, including browns, greens, and soft blue. The scene conveys movement and the vastness of the open plains.

artworks.title: Nayas Village at Sunset
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from a slight elevation overlooking a settlement area filled with small wooden structures surrounded by lush, green trees. There are tree trunks arranged to resemble canoes, people, and structures nearby. Figures are visible moving about in the scene, indicating activity. In the background, there is a wide expanse of water leading towards distant landmasses on the horizon which is positioned at the upper third of the composition. The sky is painted with expressive brushstrokes in shades of yellow and soft green, suggesting either dawn or dusk. The dominant color palette consists of earthy greens and browns close to us, while the sky features warm and contrasting colors, creating a lively yet serene visual impact.

artworks.title: Nayas Village at Night
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a circular framed scene viewed at a slight downward angle. The serene nighttime landscape includes a group of figures gathered around a small campfire. Lush silhouettes of trees rise to the left, blending into the night sky. In the lower part of the frame, a vast expanse of water or a lake meets the sky, reflecting the moonlight partially obscured by clouds. The brushstrokes are smooth, offering a sense of calm stability. The color palette consists of deep blues, blacks, and subtle crimson tones from the campfire, creating an atmosphere of quiet stillness and soft light.

artworks.title: An Indian Ladder - Nayas Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The painting shows a coastal scene from an elevated viewpoint. The horizon splits the image between the sky and the sea. A sailboat can be seen on the horizon. On the left, there are tall trees with thin trunks and lush foliage. The color palette transitions from greens and browns to yellows and oranges in the sky with scattered clouds. Below the trees, there are figures on a cliff overlooking more figures on the shoreline.

artworks.title: Five Caribbe Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows five individuals standing in various positions. They have distinctive facial features, long black hair styled with feathers, and minimal clothing made from animal skins. Some have painted patterns or tattoos on their bodies. They hold objects like spears or staffs adorned with feathers. In the background is a light, neutral-colored backdrop with a hint of blue and sparse vegetation, indicating an outdoor setting.

artworks.title: Three Woyaway Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: Three individuals are shown in full body in the image. The person on the far left leans against a rocky surface holding a bow, with long, dark hair adorned with feathers and wearing red fabric around their waist. The central figure stands holding a bow, wearing a fringed garment and feathers in their hair. The person on the right poses with one knee raised, holding a spear, with dark hair adorned with feathers and wearing jewelry and light-colored fabric around their waist. The background shows a painted scene with soft brown and green tones, resembling natural terrain with foliage on the left side.

artworks.title: Three Taruma Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals standing side by side in full-body view. The two on the left appear to be men with long dark hair, traditional body adornments, and colorful headdresses. One of them holds a bow and arrows. The individual on the right appears to be a woman with long braided hair, wearing necklaces and a patterned shawl. In the background is a structure resembling a traditional dwelling and figures beside it. The ground is grassy, and the background is cloudy on a brown and green canvas.

artworks.title: Four Goo-a-give Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts four individuals. There are two adults on the left, one holding a spear with feathers, with a child next to them. The adult on the far right is seated or crouching on a rock. All four individuals have dark hair with red and white feathers. They have strong facial features and a similar hairstyle, with shoulder-length hair. They wear minimal clothing - short wraps or cloths. They wear necklaces, and one person has arm ornaments. The background is neutral with subtle earth tones and light foliage. Simple green border frames the image.
